newsitem.title: UK: Granada in UK deal with Marco Pierre White.
newsitem.headline: Granada in UK deal with Marco Pierre White.

text.p: Celebrity chef Marco Pierre White is to set up and run restaurants in at least seven Forte hotels in Britain, UK leisure company Granada Group Plc Plc said on Thursday.
The first restaurant will be in the Meridien Piccadilly hotel in the heart of London and will open in early September. The rest will be rolled out over the next 18 months.
White, who was brought up in northern England after the death of his Italian mother, is the only British chef to gain three Michelin stars.
Granada Chief Executive Charles Allen said the seven hotels would offer "some of the finest restaurants in the world".
"The introduction of a series of first class branded restaurants, operated by a renowned chef, marks a new concept for hotel catering," Allen said in a statement.
The restaurants will be branded individually but all will incorporate the Marco Pierre White name.

Granada acquired a range of businesses from luxury hotels to more prosaic "Little Chef" roadside restaurants when it took over the Forte catering empire for 3.9 billion pounds ($6.2 billion) last year. ($ = 0.624 British Pounds)
